title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ava Morgan
description: Add a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts. Motivation: give developers battle-tested starter kits for common RAG patterns (customer support FAQ bot, knowledge base QA, code search assistant) and concrete tool-calling examples (HTTP lookup, SQL snippets, calendar API) so teams can iterate quickly without wiring infra. Changes include new example apps in /examples/rag, docs site quickstart pages and tutorial, TypeScript and Python snippets, and a small set of integration tests. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and starter prompts - [x] Add tool-calling examples and adapter snippets - [x] Docs quickstarts and tutorial pages - [x] Integration tests for example playbooks - [x] Update docs navbar and sidebar - [x] Add release notes. This PR is targeted at improving first-time developer velocity for RAG use cases and providing canonical patterns to avoid common pitfalls (cache invalidation, prompt leakage, failure handling when tools error).

motivation_context: Teams repeatedly asked for canonical RAG patterns and safe tool-calling examples. This PR packages patterns and docs to reduce repeated implementations across customers and internal demos. It consolidates previous community snippets into maintained examples and links to Redwood runtime settings (batching, cache TTL) recommended for each template.
notes_for_release: Docs: add link to new 'RAG quickstart' on homepage. Examples: publish to examples gallery and include short video demo in next sprint. No platform rollout required.
testing_instructions: Run 'yarn examples-ci' or use GitHub Actions. For local testing set EXAMPLE_API_KEY and run python example or npm start for TS. Integration tests use a local mock retrieval service; see integration-tests/README for details.
